notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Drivers![/h3]

We would like to share this new Toon Toon Racing update and something new.. Now, our game will support new platforms, such as [b]Linux, Steam OS and Mac OS.[/b] That's right! 

We will soon have the announcement of our new game, join our discord to follow the updates and our future launch: https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FVyH2RztR24


[h2]Update notes on version 2.3.0[/h2]

- Updates to the AI ​​system to make gameplay more difficult and improve the experience.
- Display of the car name on the selection screen.
- New updates on car shaders.
- New background and logo introduction.
- Updated Steam Store artwork.
- New versions will be available soon: Linux OS and Mac OS.

notes.title: CRITICAL UPDATE VERSION 2.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello drivers![/b]

This update was focused on not only bringing news with the previous one, but bringing corrections that came from the first version. We hope you enjoy.

[b]After playing, leave us your review on the Steam page ;D[/b]

[h3][b]NEWS:[/b][/h3]
- Added 10 new racing tracks.
- Added 2 new championships.

[h3][b]FIXES:[/b][/h3]
- Selecting and deselecting championships causes a bug called "Index was out of range" the race will start without AI or UI.
- Idalina and Super Eight cars do not work when chosen.
- Auto respawn adjusted for 1 seconds.
- Removed the Minimap from gameplay - for reasons of issues and bugs.
- Forest circuit track - paddock with colision problems.
- press start screen got flick and click mouse problems.
- respawn changed to work only if the car get stuck.

notes.title: NEW HUGE UPDATE VER 2.0!!!!!
notes.content:
[b]Hello drivers![/b]

This is our huge update of Toon Toon Racing to the version 2.0!!
[b]Don't forget to let us a Review in our page of Steam, this is really important for us :D[/b]

[h3][b]NEWS:[/b][/h3]
- Now we have 23 new cars! The new car selection can be found by your prefered racing style; Classic, Adventure, Roadster and Exotics.
- Added 8 new racing tracks.
- Added 3 new championships.
- Added credits in the Settings menu.
- Added new light effects and filter visual on track scenario.
- Added random music in each scenario.
- Now the racing tracks come in 3 versions: day, night and mirror.


[h3][b]FIXES:[/b][/h3]
- Suspension, tires and car speed physics receive new adjusts.
- all tracks received physics to avoid drifting during the race.
- all tracks received a properly wall collision to enhance your gameplay experience.
- Stuck cars automatically return to the lane in 1.5 seconds.
- Removed Sound system selection from gameplay pause.
- Removed Language system selection from gameplay pause.
- Removed the old track selection in game menu.
- Auto respawn adjusted for 1,5 seconds.

[h3]More updates will coming, stay on in our Discord:[/h3] https://discord.gg/VyH2RztR24

notes.title: Details of the update of 29 April 2023.
notes.content:
[b]Hello drivers![/b]

This is our first update of [b]Toon Toon Racing[/b] to the [b]version 1.1[/b]

[h1][b]NEWS:[/b][/h1]
- Two new cars - Barracuda and Mini TT.
- New MiniMap.
- New suspension system.

[h1][b]FIXES:[/b][/h1]
- Big changes and fixes on the scenario Citybay.
- Small changes and fixes on the scenario GreenHill.
- Corrections aplied on Chinese, Korean,Japanase and Russian translations.
- AI has different colors now.
- All tracks has different AI drivers.
- Small changes and fixes on Tires.
- Small changes on Car Camera.
- Auto respawn adjusted for 03 seconds.

More updates will coming, stay on in our [b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/VyH2RztR24
